title: The aim
text: Take every territory on the board. There are 42. Knock a player out by taking their last one. The last player standing holds the world, and wins.

title: Setting up
text:
Each player counts out armies: 35 each with three players, 30 with four, 25 with five, 20 with six.

Take turns putting one army on any empty territory until all 42 are claimed. Then keep taking turns adding one army to a territory you already hold, until everyone has run out.

With two players, each takes 40 armies and a third, neutral army of 40 shares the board. Tell me who holds what under Map.

title: A turn has three parts
text: First you get new armies and place them. Then you may attack. Then you may fortify once. I announce each part, and the button moves on to the next.

title: New armies
text:
Count your territories, divide by three and drop the remainder. You always get at least three.

Holding a whole continent adds more: Asia 7, North America 5, Europe 5, Africa 3, South America 2, Australia 2.

I do this sum for you. Keep Map up to date and the number on screen is right.

title: Attacking
text:
Attack from one of your territories into an enemy territory that touches it. You need at least two armies there, because one always stays behind.

The attacker rolls one, two or three dice, and needs at least one more army than dice. The defender rolls one die, or two if they have two armies or more.

Put the highest attack die against the highest defence die. Higher wins; a tie goes to the defender. The loser removes one army. If both rolled two or more, do the same with the next highest pair.

Attack as often as you like, or not at all. Battle rolls the dice for you.

title: Taking a territory
text:
When the last defending army is gone, the territory is yours. Move in at least as many armies as the dice you just rolled, and leave at least one behind.

Tap Territory taken so I can keep count.

Knock a player out and you take all their cards. If that leaves you with six or more in hand, trade sets at once, without waiting for your next turn.

title: Cards
text:
If you took at least one territory this turn, take one card when the turn ends. Only one, however many you took.

A set is three cards with the same picture, or one of each picture. A wild card stands in for any picture.

Trade a set at the start of your turn for extra armies: 4 for the first set anyone trades, then 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, and five more each time after that. If a card in your set shows a territory you hold, put two extra armies there.

Holding five cards means you must trade.

title: Fortifying
text:
To end your turn you may make one move: shift armies from one of your territories to another of yours that touches it. Leave at least one behind.

Then press the button and the next player begins.
